summary: Auto-link uploaded files to current session + strict-mode toast after upload in sage-workspace and index pages
final_report:
Implemented auto-linking of uploaded files to the current session plus a strict-mode toast (T86).

static/sage-workspace.html:
- Added .composer-toast CSS (background var(--surface), border-left 3px solid var(--foam), padding var(--space-3), font-size 13px, tokens from the page's :root), .composer-toast__btn pill button, toastIn keyframe, @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.toast-in{animation:none}}, .composer-toast[hidden]{display:none}, and .phase-badge[data-grounding="strict"]::after indicator.
- Added <div class="composer-toast" id="composer-toast" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden> next to composer-error.
- In workspace_upload_fix IIFE: new functions hide_link_toast, show_link_toast(count), enable_strict_mode, link_files_to_session(uploaded). handle_files_direct and submit_upload now parse the upload response (array of FileRecord), keep refresh_files_list(), then await link_files_to_session(uploaded) which POSTs {file_ids:[ids]} to /api/sessions/{sessionId}/files. On success shows toast '✓ N file(s) linked to this session.' with a 'Strict mode — answer only from these' button that PATCHes /api/sessions/{sessionId} {grounding_mode:'strict'}, hides the toast, sets phase-badge dataset.grounding='strict', and confirms via composer status. Toast auto-dismisses after 8s (timer reset on re-upload). If no sessionId: composer error 'Create a session first.' Link/PATCH failures surface as friendly composer errors.
notes: Declared set respected exactly: static/sage-workspace.html, static/index.html, .agents/jobs/T86.json. Jobs folder read first; no in-flight writer overlap (T-fix-buttons, T-word-anim, fix-anim, T-cleanup2, T-anim-debug all status=done). Working tree already carried uncommitted changes from those done tasks before I started (pre-edit tree: workspace 1672 lines, index 1223 lines); my edits stack on top of that disk state. My own deltas: workspace +79, index +77 vs pre-edit tree. line_counts.before uses HEAD (git show | bundled wc -l) per convention. index.html has no #phase-badge element (verified by grep), so there the strict-mode confirmation is shown via composer status and loadSessionsList() refresh instead of a badge update. Backend contract verified in source: POST /api/files returns list[FileRecord] (id field); POST /api/sessions/{id}/files takes SelectFilesBody{file_ids}; PATCH /api/sessions/{id} takes PatchSessionBody{grounding_mode}; SessionCreate requires goal min_length 1 (index.html derives goal from uploaded file names when creating a session first). Verification: node --check PASS on all 4 extracted inline script blocks (2 per file); behavioral verification (live upload/link/toast flow) handed to Merlin.
